name: Minnesota Youth Council
what_you_do: Be one of the young people who advise the Governor and state lawmakers on issues that affect youth. You research issues, meet your legislators and hold a town hall in your district.
who_can_apply: Minnesota residents ages 13 to 19 who attend a middle or high school in Minnesota. Four representatives come from each of the eight congressional districts, plus at-large seats. Applicants should be active in their community and know the three branches of Minnesota government.
pay_detail: The Council pages do not mention pay or a stipend.
duration: Two-year term. You travel to the Twin Cities area at least five times a year for retreats, Youth Day at the Capitol and hearings.
deadline_text: The 2026 round (for the 2026 to 2028 term) took applications from January to March 2026: Feb 28 for priority consideration, Mar 31 for all applications. No 2027 dates are posted. Seats also open when members graduate or step down.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application, then interview in spring. Selected applicants meet the Council director with a trusted adult in May and are sworn in. You may get a follow-up call or text.
notes: The apply page has a caption with an older appointment date from the last round, so trust the Feb 28 and Mar 31 dates above. Full Council meetings are usually one Sunday afternoon a month. Check the apply page again in January 2027.
